From Enigma · Price: only on @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened} targets.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: fold a paper and seal an object inside it.
  • 5: Surge: seal a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened} creature into paper (@Check[will|against:stand|traits:incapacitation]{Will}, incapacitation): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1} on a failure; sealed for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • 9: Frightened 1 is enough.
  • 13: Seal two creatures.
  • 17: Sealing lasts 1 minute.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
